blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) is developing a digital tracking system to keep tabs on state aid beneficiaries in real-time to prevent duplication and overpayments This information came from Guimaras Rep. Joaquin Carlos Rahman Nava on Thursday as he sponsored the DSWD’s proposed P241.56 billion budget for next year. He faced questions from Philreca Rep. Presley de Jesus over the agency’s efforts to cut beneficiaries who have already reached self-sufficiency, after state auditors flagged overpayments. “There’s a new system that is being installed and will be functional by the end of this year, and that […]...
